items.canonical_h2: Failure 不再是单进程退出
items.local_subsection: 跨设施训练先等待资源，再讨论通信效率

items.canonical_h2: 风险管理而不是一次性认证
items.local_subsection: BYOK 保护调用凭据，不自动保护响应路径
items.current_mechanism: The subsection separates provider credential authentication from response-path integrity and defines a provider-signed response envelope as a proposed provenance contract before action admission.
items.boundary_check: The body explicitly states that exact-v1 demonstrates relay-side tampering only; provider-signed responses and attested relays are future defenses not implemented or evaluated in v1, and signatures do not prove correctness, safety or absence of hallucination.
items.insert_after_anchor: 不构成对任意 provider、protocol 或 Agent workflow 的端到端安全证明。

items.canonical_h2: 隐私约束会改变可观测性的数据平面
items.local_subsection: Differential Privacy 必须覆盖事件发布与告警语义
items.current_mechanism: The monitoring contract joins event-level adjacency, temporal sensitivity, privacy-barrier placement, noisy releases and tree/composition accounting into one state machine, while downstream alerts remain post-processing.
items.boundary_check: The body explicitly says the paper does not prove arbitrary alert-policy correctness or general telemetry, attack-model or production-SLO applicability and preserves controlled raw-evidence access where aggregation is unsuitable.
items.insert_after_anchor: telemetry、攻击模型或生产 SLO 下均可用。

items.local_subsection: 从对称 Pair Gradient 到 Probability-geometry Gate
items.current_mechanism: The branch uses rejected-response probability geometry only as an update sensor that attenuates rejected-gradient magnitude, leaving optimizer commit and preference-truth ownership outside the gate.
items.boundary_check: The prose rejects the earlier gradient-conflict/noisy-pair interpretation, preserves vanilla DPO plus independent likelihood/KL monitoring when calibration is weak, and limits results to the evaluated architectures and preference datasets.
items.insert_after_anchor: 数据噪声或长期行为都更优。

items.local_subsection: 异步工作不必永久绑定固定 Physical Core
items.current_mechanism: The execution-runtime branch gives asynchronous work a virtual execution-resource identity and makes readiness-aware physical-core binding dynamic while completion, visibility and committed output stay owned by the execution plan.
items.boundary_check: The body names scheduler/state/fairness/deadlock costs, preserves fixed hardware scheduling when suspend/resume cannot be proved, and limits evidence to four disclosed LLM workloads and GH200/H100/RTX 6000 Pro without exporting throughput headlines.
items.insert_after_anchor: 本章只吸收 resource binding 变成 runtime decision 的机制，不外推 headline 吞吐。

items.local_subsection: 连续 Edge Inference 需要跨窗口携带 Violation-risk Budget
items.current_mechanism: The scheduler carries stream identity, burst/device history, an evolving-horizon estimate and remaining deadline-violation risk across windows; the predictor proposes and the risk accountant constrains admission.
items.boundary_check: The text denies that risk budget is success truth or a substitute for hard safety deadlines, preserves EDF/reservation/hard-cap admission under stable or uncalibrated conditions, and binds evidence to the disclosed continuous-edge assumptions.
items.insert_after_anchor: 不证明任意模型、硬件、并发或安全控制周期。
